title: Duo: Towards Spatiotemporal Action Coordination in Bimanual Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.32108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bimanual manipulation requires each arm to perform distinct motions while coordinating with the other. Common flow-based robotic policies combine both arms' actions into one token per future timestep, giving attention distinct positions across time but not across arms. We introduce Duo, a simple but effective design that models spatial and temporal dependencies within one shared action head. Specifically, Duo separates both arms into two action tokens per timestep, allowing each arm's motion to interact via cross-arm attention during flow matching. On RoboTwin 2.0, Duo improves the overall success of all four base policies, from 0.45B to 3.62B parameters, with gains of 12.55 and 9.02 percentage points for FLOWER (0.89B) and $\pi_{0.5}$ (3.62B), respectively. Despite its compact size, FLOWER-Duo achieves the best randomized-generalization, precision, and memory scores on RoboDojo. In real-world tasks, it outperforms $\pi_{0.5}$ in both

translated_title: Duo：迈向双手策略中的时空动作协调
translated_abstract: 双手操作要求每条手臂执行不同的动作，同时与另一条手臂协调配合。常见的基于流的机器人策略将双臂的动作合并为每个未来时间步的一个token，使注意力在时间维度上具有不同的位置，但在手臂维度上则没有。我们提出了Duo，这是一种简单而有效的设计，可以在一个共享的动作头中建模空间和时间依赖关系。具体而言，Duo将双臂在每个时间步分离为两个动作token，使每条手臂的动作能够在流匹配过程中通过跨手臂注意力进行交互。在RoboTwin 2.0上，Duo提升了所有四种基础策略（参数量从0.45B到3.62B）的总体成功率，其中FLOWER（0.89B）和π₀.₅（3.62B）分别提升了12.55和9.02个百分点。尽管其规模紧凑，FLOWER-Duo在RoboDojo上取得了最佳的随机泛化、精度和内存分数。在真实世界任务中，它在两方面均优于π₀.₅……
tldr: Duo通过在共享动作头中将双臂分离为独立的动作token并引入跨手臂注意力机制，在流匹配过程中实现双手操作的空间-时间动作协调，使多种基础策略的成功率显著提升。
en_tdlr: Duo achieves spatiotemporal action coordination in bimanual policies by separating both arms into distinct action tokens with cross-arm attention during flow matching, significantly boosting success rates across multiple base policies.
